 Hayley Williams to kick off Asia tour with Manila stop
 Pauline Songco · 18 November 2026 · 9:46 PM PHT · 2 MIN READ 
 HAYLEY Williams
 Photograph courtesy of Elise Joseph James SINGER-SONGWRITER
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save Filipino fans will be the first in Asia to see Hayley Williams’ latest solo concert as the singer opens The Hayley Williams Show in Manila next year.
 The tour will begin on 24 February 2027 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, marking the first stop of Williams’ four-city Asian run before heading to Singapore, Seoul and Tokyo.
 Promoted by Ovation Productions and AEG Presents Asia, the Manila concert follows the North American, United Kingdom and European legs of the tour, which included sold-out performances at venues such as the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles and Espaço Unimed in São Paulo.

 Pauline Joyce Pascual · 7 November 2026 
 The Hayley Williams Show comes after Williams toured in support of her latest solo album, Ego Death At A Bachelorette Party, which earned Grammy nominations and a Libera Award. That tour featured the singer performing the album in its entirety each night.
 The new show expands beyond a single record, with Williams set to perform songs spanning all three of her solo albums alongside new surprises for audiences.
 Outside her solo career, Williams remains best known as the frontwoman of Paramore, whose albums Brand New Eyes, After Laughter and This Is Why helped establish the band as one of alternative rock’s defining acts.
 Paramore made history in 2024 after This Is Why won Best Rock Album at the Grammy Awards, making the group the first female-fronted rock band to receive the honor since the category was introduced.
 Williams also received four Grammy nominations for Ego Death At A Bachelorette Party, including Best Alternative Music Album and nominations for the songs “Parachute,” “Mirtazapine” and “Glum.”
 Artist pre-sale runs from 12 p.m. on 18 November until 11:59 p.m. on 19 November, while general ticket sales begin at 12 p.m. on 20 November through TicketNet outlets and online.
 Following Manila, The Hayley Williams Show will continue to Singapore on 26 February, Seoul on 1 March and Tokyo on 3 March.
